arXiv math/0409565 = LP2004 'Unital Gröbner Bases over Arbitrary Commutative Ground Rings' (10 pp.). Content: §2 unital GB definitions, Buchberger over R, PBW corollary. NO inner products, NO intertwiners, NO representation theory beyond GB-representations. Verified-clean for content/unital-groebner-bases/.../groebner-basis.lean (cites Definition 5 of LP2004 — exact match). MISMATCH for content/quantum-observable-universe/quantum-observable-universes/pawlowski-leitner-inner-product.lean and content/quantum-observable-universe/lean/QOU/RepresentationTheory.lean — both cite leitnerpawloski2004 for 'PL inner product' / 'PL basis dimension formula', neither of which appears in LP2004. Likely a different Pawlowski-Leitner work (Pawlowski's thesis or a separate representation-theory paper). Author decision pending: (a) add a new bib entry for the actual cited work, (b) change the QOU citation key, or (c) update the QOU content to match LP2004's actual scope. | ADDITIONAL 6 bare-URL Refs upgraded with arxiv preprint info. Confirms the prior partial verification (commit 4abfedfda): the cited 'On the morphisms of non-commutative formal groups' is the SAME math/0409565 — so QOU is consistently citing this work for the Gröbner-bases foundation, with the 2 mismatched 'PL inner product' / 'PL basis' lean files being the only outliers.
